SELECT comment_content, comment_no, parent_no, freeboard_no, DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS reg_dt, DATE_FORMAT(mod_dt, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS mod_dt, user_id, COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN c.user_role = 'ADMIN' THEN '관리자' ELSE c.login_id END FROM seinfo_vendor_manager c WHERE user_id = c.user_email), '탈퇴회원') AS author_id, IFNULL(like_count, 0) AS like_count, IFNULL(hate_count, 0) AS hate_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seinfo_freeboard_comments c2 WHERE c2.parent_no = c1.comment_no ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_child FROM seinfo_freeboard_comments c1 WHERE freeboard_no = #{freeboardNo} AND parent_no IS NULL ORDER BY reg_dt ASC

SELECT comment_content, comment_no, parent_no, freeboard_no, DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS reg_dt, DATE_FORMAT(mod_dt, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS mod_dt, user_id, COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN c.user_role = 'ADMIN' THEN '관리자' ELSE c.login_id END FROM seinfo_vendor_manager c WHERE user_id = c.user_email), '탈퇴회원') AS author_id, IFNULL(like_count, 0) AS like_count, IFNULL(hate_count, 0) AS hate_count FROM seinfo_freeboard_comments WHERE parent_no = #{parentNo} ORDER BY reg_dt ASC;
